facts.fact: Programmatic video advertising is the automated buying and selling of video ad inventory through a digital advertising platform, using real-time bidding and data-driven algorithms.
facts.quote: Programmatic video advertising is the automated buying and selling of video ad inventory through a [digital advertising platform]

facts.fact: An interstitial video ad is a full-screen ad covering the entire screen or interface of an app, typically shown at natural transition points such as between levels of a mobile game.
facts.quote: An interstitial video ad is a full-screen ad that covers the entire screen or interface of an app, typically appearing during natural transition points

facts.fact: Per a HubSpot citation in the article, 75% of viewers prefer to watch short-form video content on their mobile devices.
facts.quote: prefer to watch short-form video content on their mobile devices

facts.fact: StackAdapt advises creating video ads that convey a message in 10–20 seconds so viewers watch in full.
facts.quote: Create ads that convey a message in 10–20 seconds to make sure viewers watch your ad in full

facts.fact: The article states that completion rates tend to drop off substantially after 30 seconds of a video ad.
